title: Apple Rankings by The Appleist Brian Frange
subtitle: Comedian Brian Frange aka The Appleist Reviews and Ranks Apples (the fruit)

posts.title: Sommerfeld Apple Review
posts.description: The perfect blend of sweet and tart, this fiery bitch is a headliner at Trader Joes nationwide. Not as snappy as you’d like, and a little rough around the edges, this hard-nosed trailblazer makes up for it’s downfalls with snappy branding. A fine Australian apple. Good for everyday use. The post Sommerfeld Apple Review appeared first on Apple Rankings by The Appleist Brian Frange .
